part.text: The current user model has only `username`, so the owner’s username is the only available notification address and will be passed as `user_email` without changing registration/auth contracts. The trigger will compare the persisted old status with the updated status, ensuring email is queued only on a transition into `completed`, not on repeated completed updates.

I’m adding a standalone Celery configuration and task module, then wiring `.delay()` after the database transaction commits so broker dispatch cannot hold the SQLite transaction open. Tests will mock the Celery task and verify both positive and negative transition cases.
